about: Batch 34 (13 Nov 2026), the owner: 'Fix it' - the early lay's forecast was fitted on the out-of-sample prices of the 10 Nov stack while the live price came from batch 32's stack (released 13 Nov). Not a model comparison: one arm, the live recipe stack_m (sixteen tables) fitted on the 29 months before 6 Oct 2026, every day from 6 Oct priced as the live model serves it (the stretched SP forecast), published to greyhound/live/oos_prices_stack_m for the forecast fit (greyhound.laytest live_prices). A 1,500-second cap on each tree seed, as batch 19.
